systems.name: Core Banking System
systems.description: Heart of all financial operations — accounts, ledger, transactions, reconciliation. Handles 2M+ transactions/day.
known_issues: PR #847: OAuth→PKCE migration (breaking change)
Nightly batch deadlock fixed in PR #809

systems.name: Mobile Banking App
systems.description: Customer-facing React Native app serving 4M+ users on iOS and Android. Real-time balance, UPI, bill pay.
known_issues: Session timeout edge case on biometric re-auth

systems.name: Payment Gateway
systems.description: Processes all inbound/outbound payments: NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, international wires. 50K TPS capacity.
known_issues: International wire SWIFT timeout above 30s needs retry logic

systems.name: Fraud Detection Engine
systems.description: ML-based real-time fraud scoring. Evaluates every transaction in <50ms using behavioral + rule-based models.
known_issues: Model drift alerts if >2 weeks without retraining

systems.name: KYC / AML Service
systems.description: Know Your Customer & Anti-Money Laundering compliance. Integrates with CKYC registry, UIDAI, Experian.
known_issues: UIDAI API rate limits at 10K requests/min — throttling in place

systems.name: API Gateway
systems.description: Central entry point for all external traffic. Handles auth, rate limiting, routing, observability.
known_issues: Rate limit config pushed via PR #831 — 100 req/min per client

systems.name: Loan Origination System
systems.description: End-to-end loan processing — application, underwriting, credit scoring, disbursement. Handles 5K applications/day.
known_issues: PR #201: Race condition in disbursement saga — double disbursement risk patched

systems.name: Notification Service
systems.description: Omnichannel notification platform — SMS, Push, Email, WhatsApp. 10M+ messages/day.
known_issues: WhatsApp Business API quota limits during month-end statements

systems.name: Card Management System
systems.description: Issues and manages credit/debit cards — Visa, Mastercard, RuPay. Controls limits, blocks, EMI conversion.
known_issues: HSM failover takes ~90s — known latency spike on key rotation

systems.name: Treasury Management System
systems.description: Manages bank liquidity, ALM, forex positions, investment portfolio. Used by treasury desk daily.
known_issues: Bloomberg API disconnect at market close needs auto-reconnect

systems.name: Data Analytics Platform
systems.description: Real-time and batch analytics. Powers dashboards, regulatory reports, customer 360, risk metrics.
known_issues: BigQuery slot contention during month-end — scale-up needed

systems.name: Digital Onboarding
systems.description: Paperless account opening — video KYC, document upload, e-sign, instant account activation.
known_issues: Video KYC drops on 2G networks — adaptive bitrate needed

text_curriculum_modules.title: Curriculum strand 1: platform literacy
objectives: Explain how a change propagates from IDE to canary
Map a user story to owning services
List mandatory compliance checkpoints
text_curriculum_modules.body_md:
### Strand 1

1. **Context**: Engineering here is socio-technical — code, contracts, and committees.
2. **Practice**: Trace one production alert to the owning service graph node.
3. **Reflection**: Write three failure modes your feature could introduce.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  dev[Dev] --> ci[CI]
  ci --> stg[Staging]
  stg --> can[Canary]
  can --> prod[Prod]
```

quiz.question: What must precede prod traffic on a new API?
options: Threat model + authZ review + SLO definition
quiz.rationale: Regulated environments require explicit controls and measurable SLOs before exposure.

quiz.question: Best artifact for cross-team alignment?
quiz.rationale: ADRs create durable, searchable decisions.

hands_on_lab.title: Lab 1: synthetic trace
steps: Clone sandbox service template
Inject OpenTelemetry span linking to CBS mock
Export trace JSON and annotate critical path
